# Employee Handbook

## Paid Time Off

All full-time employees receive 20 paid time off days per year. Part-time employees
accrue paid time off on a pro-rata basis. Contractors are not entitled to paid time off.
Unused paid time off days do not carry over into the following calendar year.

## Insurance

The company provides health insurance to all full-time employees. Coverage begins on the
first day of employment. Employees must enroll within 30 days of their start date.
